selection.segmentQuery: segment=<id> keeps an outlet when any of its banners is in that segment and counts only those banners (projectSegment returns a copy; rows are never mutated)
selection.areaFocusQuery: areas=comma-separated production Locale uuids (≤ 3) or areas=all to disable auto focus
selection.neighborhoodQuery: neighborhood=<production Locale uuid> — the same id as /v3/citymeter/BKK/L/<uuid>
selection.provinceQuery: province=<production code of any of the 77 provinces in js/model.js PROVINCES (base/info/lv0 abbrEn, e.g. BKK, CMI, NST, UTT)>; Thai and English names still resolve
selection.cameraQuery: view3d=0 forces the plan preset; cam=model switches the venue-level camera from eye (default) to model; legacy cam=eye is accepted
selection.panelQuery: store=<outlet id CAM-O-…> opens store mode; place=<CityMETER host id: the Shopping Center id of the master join; a Grocery record id is supported when the master joins one> opens venue mode; neighborhood=<Locale uuid> opens neighborhood mode
selection.legacyMallQuery: mall=<host id> narrows the venue filter to that host's label when present

developerWorkflow: Read AGENTS.md, then handoff/README.md, PRODUCT_STATEMENT.md and the paired human/machine briefs
Run npm test before changes; keep the three row scopes, the focus modes, the banner counting rule and the panel action contract
Change one bounded task at a time; preserve the brief's invariant IDs
Data changes go through scripts/build-camera-data.py and scripts/extract-provinces.mjs, never hand edits; snapshot fixtures in tests/ fail on purpose when the data changes

Host points and host buildings come from the research master (venue join, 13_BUILDINGS); never place, re-match or upgrade a host in the app — app matches go to host_link_proposals.csv for the research team
Validate calculations with the real dataset in tests/; tile-dependent code uses tests/fixtures/mvt-sample.pbf
Review rendered Thai/English at 390 px and desktop in both themes; use the stub-tile harness when CDN/tiles are blocked, then confirm the real-tile look live
Tune camera and massing live via window.__citymeter in the console before changing constants
Publish only authorized changes; wait for the Pages run; run verify:live before reporting a release
Regenerate the manifest and bundle from final bytes; never hand-edit hashes
3D layer order is a contract: host extrusion first, massing tiers inserted before it, venue-xray last — check with map.getStyle().layers / map.getLayer after any spatial change
